title: [DEV] Crash on trying to enter minutes in TT window
body:
Build: 92558e9d65-2023.09.25
Time: 08:21
Log: [AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/12723522/AndroidAPS.log)

App crash when trying to enter duration in temp target dialog

How to reproduce:

- Open TT dialog
- Press the minutes field, so keyboard will pop op
- App will crash

comments.body: same here, app crashes by entering the first digit

> mine don't crash android version?

Mine is also OK.
I'm with Microsoft Swiftkey keyboard.

tested on 
Android 11 (analog clock appear - no keyboard)
Androd12 (digital clock appear - keyboard popup)
no crash so far

Pixel 6Pro android 13 > Crash
Redmi Note with custom rom android 11 also crash.

Will see if I can create stacktrace later today

in my case it is on a Pixel 5 with Android 13 and it seems to be in every case where a numeric keyboard is used. I tried TT and bolus assistent and both did crash. I went back to the version from 15.09.2023.
